{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Total number of enrolled patients
n_total = len(df)

# Number of patients with severe baseline disease
n_severe = df['severity'].value_counts().get('severe', 0)

# Fraction of enrolled patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = n_severe / n_total

print(f'Total patients: {n_total}')
print(f'Patients with severe severity: {n_severe}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')"}
